# Ihor Shulha — Software Engineer Portfolio

> Ihor Shulha is a Lead Backend / AI / Cloud Software Engineer based in Germany, open to freelance work and collaboration. He designs, builds and supports end-to-end services — from cloud infrastructure to AI-powered features. Website: https://ihorshulha.dev · LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/ihorshulha · GitHub: https://github.com/IhorShulha8 · Email: ihorshulha@mail.online-impressum.de · Languages: English, German (formal), Ukrainian.

## Summary

Personal portfolio of a professional Software Engineer with 7+ years building scalable, fault-tolerant systems for Fintech, Healthcare, and SaaS. Core stack: Java (up to Java 21), Spring Boot, Kotlin, Go, Python, AWS. Takes ownership of the entire product lifecycle — from cloud architecture to mobile apps and AI integration into real business features.

## Services

- **Backend Engineering**: High-throughput microservices and event-driven architectures with measurable SLOs — Java, Spring Boot, Kotlin, Go, Python.
- **AI Integration**: LLM APIs, Spring AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, on-premise LLM deployments (Ollama) for data privacy.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS architecture (EKS, Lambda, ECS), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, IaC with Terraform and Docker, observability via OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana.
- **Fullstack & Mobile**: End-to-end apps from database design to Angular web and Flutter mobile clients.

## Case Studies

- [Cloud Billing SaaS](https://ihorshulha.dev/#work): High-throughput invoice processing pipeline with continuous high availability. Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS.
- [Modular Payments Platform](https://ihorshulha.dev/#work): Multiple payment providers with cascade failover and real-time analytics. Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, AWS, PostgreSQL.
- [Realtime Collaboration Service](https://ihorshulha.dev/#work): Low-latency document synchronization via WebSockets and Redis. Stack: Java, Spring Boot, WebSocket, Redis.
- [Healthcare Integration Suite](https://ihorshulha.dev/#work): Secure IoT device integration compliant with US medical-device standards (Class B). Stack: Java, Spring, Cassandra, gRPC.
- [eCommerce Admin Toolkit](https://ihorshulha.dev/#work): API-first admin panel for catalogs, orders and customer analytics. Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, Angular, PostgreSQL.
- [Wellness Tracker App](https://ihorshulha.dev/#work): Cross-platform mobile app with cloud sync and push notifications. Stack: Flutter, Firebase, REST.
